title: Name it, connect it
goal: Give a number a name so many shapes can share it.

steps.say: Point at state. A name you give a number so you can reuse it.
Click the 20 and choose name this number. Call it size.
Pick the 20 and the 40 together and choose connect. The 40 is size times two.
Both circles now follow one number. Change size and both change.
